title: Not Unless I Get To Choose
text:
First box was just okay. The bandanas are not a true bandana & does not stay on my dog.

2nd box was a disappointment. Let them know my dog does not like peanut butter and he's a male. They sent peanut butter treats & a pink "bandana." Requested a refund but they never got back to me. Canceled my subscription.
label: negative
